title: Square Dance Caller
tagline: Name the figures and bring the whole square home.
description: Square dancing is a folk dance of the United States. You are the caller: tap a figure, see where every dancer would go, sing it to the fiddle and keep a phrase ahead. Tips, Endless Evening, Practice, Learn lessons, Think hints and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Every dancer has a colour; every place has a ring in its owner's colour.
Tap a call to preview where each dancer goes.
Tap it again, or Call it, to sing it during the next phrase.
Stay a phrase ahead: if no call is ready the floor swings partners.
Bring all eight dancers home in as few phrases as you can.
